lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in a structured 2D grid along the mid-lateral flank, forming approximately five distinct horizontal rows that extend from the posterior margin of the gill slits toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignments of circular spots, forming a lattice where the highest luminance nodes serve as primary grid anchors.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity surface reflection to a shadowed lower region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with a slightly higher concentration on the anterior and basal surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. Several dark, elongated pixel clusters indicative of remoras are attached to the ventral and pectoral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible: one attached near the right pectoral fin and at least three others trailing near the ventral-posterior region of the shark.
